# Joyanta Deb Gupta - Portfolio

## About
Joyanta Deb Gupta is a Senior Electrical Design Engineer with 10+ years of expertise in MV/LV systems, substation design, and industrial electrification in Bangladesh.

## Professional Summary
- Lead electrical design and project execution for medium and low voltage systems
- Expertise in 33/11kV AIS and GIS substation design, grid projects up to 230/132kV
- Experience with power transformers, VCBs, and switchgear
- Utility tender engineering: bid packages, BOQs and vendor pricing (DESCO, BPDB, PGCB)
- IR testing programmes (HIOKI IR4056) and DIALux lighting design
- Compliance expertise: BNBC 2020, NFPA 70/72/780
- Auditing experience: RSC, Nirapon, Elevate, DIFE, Bureau Veritas

## Work Experience
1. **Assistant Manager – Electrical Design & Projects** at Novelty Infrastructures Limited (Nov 2019 – Present)
   - Full ownership of electrical design & execution for MV/LV systems
   - Led 5 NESCO 33/11kV AIS Substations (100% on schedule)
   - Commissioned 10 Power Transformers (16/20 MVA) & 23 Outdoor VCBs
   - Leading PGCB Aricha 230/132/33kV grid substation installation & pre-commissioning
   - Closed Cox's Bazar 132/33kV AIS upgradation (3 high-capacity transformers)

2. **Site Engineer – Projects** at Siemens Bangladesh Limited (Sep 2017 – Oct 2019)
   - Supervised 24 DESCO 33/11kV GIS substations
   - Commissioned 19 Power Transformers (20/28 MVA)
   - Led National Parliament 11kV GIS Project

3. **Junior Engineer – Projects** at Novelty Engineering Corporation (Jan 2016 – Aug 2017)
   - Executed electrical rectification for 15+ factories
